column1: # regenerated: 2026-08-26 (#3288 — first live re-run since 2026-08-06; see
# entities_total 701 -> 705 (+0.6%, inside the +/-2% band) and the draw split
# moved DOWN on both gated axes: batches 47 -> 20, gpu_calls 4 -> 2. Recapturing
# a cell whose gated metrics improved tightens the contract; this is the only
# one of the five baselines regenerated this pass. fnv / fo3 / skyrim_se each
# carry a metric past a gating threshold in the WRONG direction and were left
# stale on purpose, so the evidence survives (RT-2026-08-26-01/02/04).
# (strict gate, comparable across the #3349 metric-surface widening) and
# earshuman.dds` (and its `_n` sibling) missed. Root-caused against the real
# archives (not guessed) — there is no `facegen\` top-level folder anywhere
# in Oblivion's BSAs; three vanilla NIFs (`earshuman.nif`, `earshighelf.nif`,
# `earswoodelf.nif`) bake in a FaceGen SDK export-tool path instead of the
# basename-fallback lookup gated on the `textures\facegen\` prefix
# both the diffuse and `_n` sibling now resolve) — row regenerated to 0.
# #3556/RT-10 — `light_count_directional` was derived from the mere presence
# of a `CellLightingRes` block, so it read a constant `1` on all five games
# and could never fail (#3424). The engine now parses the real per-emitter
# dump (`5f970bae`). Oblivion measures 2 directional / 8 point emitters
# (the two synthetic directionals are RT-11's finding, not a regression
# here). Added the new `light_count_point` row and corrected
# bench_fps_* is advisory only under xvfb (RT-2 / #1701) — never gate on it.
# entities_total: +/-2% tolerance metric, not exact (#1705 / RT-3).
# skin_pool_live: advisory, not a hard gate — see skin_pool_max /
